marketing_description: The NUVO 62-1784 Tape Light features edge-lit LED technology for even light distribution and is designed for flush mount or grid ceiling installation. This 40 W LED fixture has a voltage rating of 100 to 277 V and a color temperature of 4000 K, with a color rendering index of 80+. It is dimmable with 0-10V dimming capability and has a durable aluminum frame with a white finish.
